FORMAT LAW. Honour the grammar of the liquid metal morph — its native framing, its edit rhythm, and the specific thing audiences expect from it. If the format loops, the last frame must match the first.

CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a trucking shot matching the subject's walking pace on a 70-200mm zoom at 150mm, framing with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with an overcast soft dome with no directional shadow at all; grade as a filmic grade with halation on the specular highlights. Specify the sound design in one clause — what the viewer hears in the first second decides whether they stay.
